Lightning risk map (tap to open / close) Conditional on detected lightning. This is not overall wildfire risk.
Each square = a 0.1° cell (about 11 km) with lightning in the last 24 h. Colour = chance that a reported lightning-caused fire follows in the 3x3 cells around it within the next 3 days. It is not the chance of any wildfire, human-caused fires, or a guarantee. Hover a square for its inputs.

Covers Canadian land up to 66°N. Lightning north of 66°N and outside Canada is not scored. Dashed outline = Yukon/NT/Nunavut (less certain; the model was tested there with fewer fires).
